scope: r811 single real client session; read-only raw usercmd decode and 5 ms client memory sampling
hypothesis: If native firing advances the client weapon machine, at least one sampled weapon state or clip should differ during a 3 s attack hold; if the client selects weapon 78, outgoing usercmd weapon should contain 78.
snapshot_spawn_time_field: absent from decoded r738 frame (0x333c, netfield 98)
interpretation: All decoded r811 attack packets carry usercmd weapon 0 although snapshot PS weapon and primary are 78. Community C1 code treats command weapon 0 as a request for no weapon outside the 200 ms spawn grace period. This is a plausible native weapon-state blocker, not yet a demonstrated cause in this Build. The server-delivered ID54 event and unchanged clip do not prove native firing. One session, 5 ms sampling; sub-5 ms state transitions remain unobserved.
